title: Honey Sriracha Chicken with Coconut Sauce
summary: Seared chicken thighs simmered in a sweet, spicy honey, sriracha and coconut sauce, with jasmine rice and tenderstem broccoli.

items.note: plus a drizzle for the sauce

steps.heading: The chicken
steps.text: Pat the chicken thighs dry with kitchen paper. Mix the flour with salt and black pepper on a plate, then coat the thighs lightly on both sides, shaking off the excess.
Preheat a frying pan over a medium-high heat and add the vegetable oil. Once it is hot, add the chicken and sear for {timer:3-4} per side, until golden brown. Work in batches if needed.
Lift the chicken onto a plate. It will not be cooked through yet.

steps.heading: The sauce
steps.text: Turn the heat down to medium. Add a small drizzle of oil, the butter and the garlic to the same pan, and cook for {timer:1-2}, stirring constantly and scraping up the browned bits. Do not let the garlic burn.
Add the sriracha, soy sauce and honey, and stir for {timer:1-2}, until bubbling and glossy.
Pour in the coconut milk and the chicken stock, and stir well to bring in the glaze and the browned bits. Bring to a gentle boil, then turn the heat down to low.
Return the chicken and any resting juices to the pan. Simmer gently for {timer:8-12|chicken}, turning the thighs halfway.
Check that the thickest part of each thigh reaches {temp:74!}. If not, keep cooking and check again.

steps.heading: Rice and broccoli
steps.text: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clearer. Put it in a saucepan with the amount of water on the packet, bring to the boil, cover and turn the heat to low. Cook as the packet says, usually {timer:10-12|rice}, then rest it covered for {timer:5|rice rest} and fluff with a fork.

Bring a saucepan of salted water to the boil. Add the broccoli and cook for {timer:3-5|broccoli}, until bright green and tender but still slightly crunchy. Drain well. You can also steam it for {timer:4-6|broccoli}.

steps.heading: Serve
steps.text: Divide the rice between two plates. Slice the chicken into strips or serve the thighs whole, with the broccoli alongside.
Spoon plenty of the sauce over the chicken and rice, and finish with the chives and the chilli oil, if using.

tips: To cook it all together: rinse and start the rice and flour the chicken (0-5 min); sear the chicken (5-13 min); make the sauce (13-17 min); simmer the chicken while the rice cooks (17-30 min); then cook the broccoli, rest the rice and check the chicken in the last 5 minutes.
In a stainless-steel pan, preheat it before adding the oil, add the chicken once the oil is hot, and let a crust form before you try to turn it. Do not crowd the pan.
Keep the sauce at a gentle simmer: a hard boil can split the coconut milk. If it is too thin, lift out the chicken and simmer the sauce uncovered for a few minutes.
For a milder sauce use 1 tbsp sriracha; the full 2 tbsp gives it a noticeable kick.
Use 200-250 g broccoli. For the rice, the Stovetop Jasmine Rice recipe gives exact water and timings.
